title: Updating the fourth query register
statement: Let $R$ be a record of natural-number registers, and let $v\in\mathbb N$. Replacing the entry at coordinate $18$ in its length-$21$ vector of register values by $v$ gives the vector of register values of the record obtained by setting its fourth query register to $v$.
